summary: Iteration 2 retest of WebXR park app. The HIGH-priority VR button bug from iteration 1 is FIXED. Clicking [data-testid=enter-vr-button] on the headless (non-XR) browser produces ZERO uncaught pageerrors. The app correctly (a) displays the red banner [data-testid=vr-error-banner] with exact text 'Nessun dispositivo VR rilevato — puoi esplorare comunque con mouse e tastiera.' and (b) auto-falls back to desktop mode (park-experience mounted, click-to-play-prompt visible). All 5 regression flows also pass: welcome screen, desktop entry, WASD walking to bench, E-key sit/stand toggle (both directions), and exit button. Frontend at 100%.
critical_code_review_comments: ParkExperience.jsx: The 400ms setTimeout before xrStore.enterVR() is a marginal improvement over the previous 150ms but still time-based. The React-Three/XR store's enterVR() rejection is properly caught now via .catch(), so even if the timing is off the app degrades gracefully. Consider hooking into a Canvas onCreated callback for a more deterministic ready signal in future iterations.
ParkExperience.jsx: VR error banner has no dismiss/close affordance. Fine for V1 but consider auto-hiding after ~6s or providing a dismiss X for polish.
DesktopPlayer.jsx onClick handler now correctly requires document.pointerLockElement before raycasting — the accidental-sit-on-first-click regression is prevented.
Home.jsx: onVRUnavailable callback correctly switches mode to 'desktop', keeping the same ParkExperience mounted; no remount flicker observed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App URL: https://322a02a1-9f13-4254-9c03-f5cb01797288.preview.emergentagent.com/. All acceptance criteria for iteration 2 verified. VR graceful degradation works: banner + auto-fallback to desktop. Data-testids validated: welcome-screen, enter-vr-button, enter-desktop-button, welcome-step-01/02/03, park-experience, vr-error-banner, click-to-play-prompt, sit-prompt, stand-prompt, exit-park-button. To WASD-walk, always click canvas at (200,100) safe corner (avoids bench raycast on first pointer-lock click). To exit reliably in headless, call `await page.evaluate('() => document.exitPointerLock()')` before clicking exit button (Escape does not release pointer lock in headless Chromium).
verified_flows: VR button graceful degradation: 0 uncaught pageerrors, red banner with correct Italian text visible, auto-fallback to desktop mode (park-experience + click-to-play-prompt visible)
Welcome screen regression: hero + VR/Desktop buttons + 3 feature steps all render
Desktop entry: park-experience mounts, canvas renders trees + bench + path + sky
WASD walking: canvas click at (200,100) acquires pointer lock without accidental sit; holding KeyW 2s reaches bench and shows sit-prompt
E key sit/stand toggle: first E -> stand-prompt visible, sit-prompt hidden; second E -> sit-prompt reappears, stand-prompt hidden
Exit button: exitPointerLock() + click exit-park-button returns to welcome-screen
